# Isamelo Real Estate Dubai

> Find your ideal Dubai property in 60 seconds. Answer 8 quick questions and receive a hand-picked shortlist on WhatsApp, with payment plans, full costs and Golden Visa guidance included.

## About

Isamelo Real Estate is a RERA-certified Dubai brokerage helping buyers and investors find off-plan and ready properties in Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah. The site is available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## Key facts

- 0% annual property tax on Dubai property, with no tax on rental income for individuals
- 5 - 8% typical gross rental yield in established communities, ahead of London, Singapore and Hong Kong
- AED 2M property threshold for the 10-year Golden Visa
- Foreign nationals can buy freehold property in designated communities
- Budget around 4% Dubai Land Department fee and 2% agency fees on top of the purchase price

## Services

- Off-plan launches with flexible payment plans
- Ready-to-move-in units
- Budget, timeline and goal-based matching against live stock
- Shortlist delivery on WhatsApp within the hour, including floor plans, payment schedules, service charges and transfer costs
